I was able to have a thorough and reassuring consultation.
I was concerned about my cat's health, so I visited the clinic for an examination.
The receptionist was kind, and the clinic was clean and had a calm atmosphere.
The doctor listened carefully to my concerns about my cat's current symptoms, and clearly explained the necessary tests, the reasons for them, and the costs beforehand, so I was able to proceed with the examination with confidence. Thank you so much.

Having just moved and being a first-time pet owner, I had many worries and anxieties. When my pet started vomiting, I called for the first time.

The nurse who answered the phone listened carefully and then transferred me to the doctor. Although I couldn't make it to the clinic during regular hours on my way home from work, I was able to hear what the doctor had to say, which eased some of my anxiety. I'd like to make this my regular vet.
It was a very nice clinic.

My dog ​​has chronic pancreatitis and a liver nodule.

Due to her advanced age of 15, surgery is not being considered, and she is being treated with medication.

She has difficulty taking her medication and her appetite is inconsistent, but the doctor has thought about it since our last meeting and made various suggestions, and we've narrowed down her favorite foods.

The doctor is very attentive and adjusts her medication according to her changing condition. The staff are also very kind, which I appreciate.

I was very relieved to receive such a thorough explanation about my dog's condition and what I should be careful about.

I would like to continue bringing my dog ​​here.
The vet examined my dog ​​very gently and gave a thorough explanation.
The examination was quick and to the point. The staff around me were also very kind.

I use this service for health checkups, anal gland expression, and nail trimming.
At first, my dog ​​was scared, but now he's completely relaxed.
Thank you for your continued support.

Dear Mr./Ms. Kazuma Matsunaga,

Thank you very much for your kind words regarding our hospital.

We, the entire staff, will continue to strive to be a hospital where your family can feel at ease consulting with us.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns or problems.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

Kagurazaka Animal Hospital (Peco Animal Medical Center Branch)

Their response was quick and courteous, which put my mind at ease.

They did their best and I was able to immediately understand the situation with my pet.
I received kind service with no waiting time.
Thank you for the kind and thorough examination room.
Even when my dog ​​gets sick, the vet and staff are so kind and attentive and immediately take care of him, which I really appreciate.
The vet is kind, and the cat feels at ease!
It's very convenient, and everyone is so kind, so I've been using their services for a long time.
They were very kind and provided expert advice, making this the most reassuring animal hospital I've ever been to!

I came here because I was worried about receiving treatment at another clinic. The reservation website was easy to understand, making the appointment process smooth. The doctors and nurses were very attentive and carefully examined my cat's condition. They performed tests tailored to my cat's condition. ✨ I also feel reassured by the aftercare provided via LINE.
Thank you so much for your consistently kind and courteous service! I feel completely at ease coming here! I look forward to continuing to receive your care in the future.
This is my first puppy, and I'm completely clueless, but they patiently answer even my smallest questions, and things are progressing smoothly. I'm incredibly grateful.

My pet had been suffering from diarrhea for a long time, so I took him to the vet.

They listened carefully to everything from the food my pet was eating to the detailed history of his condition, and provided very thorough and attentive care.

The hospital had many thoughtful touches, such as free food available for pets to eat while waiting and cute wallpaper for taking photos.
They treated me very kindly.

I was laughed at for a mistake I had made in the electronic medical record beforehand. I am very sorry for causing you so much trouble. I will go to a different hospital in the future. Thank you for examining me despite upsetting you.

The process from check-in to examination and payment was very smooth. The head veterinarian and nurses are kind and polite. Today, our dogs were nervous about their vaccinations, but they're having fun with the toys they received when we get home. Thank you as always! 😊 …
Thank you so much for your extremely thorough examination!

I suddenly had diarrhea and my usual place was closed so I came here.
You explained everything to me so carefully and I felt relieved. Thank you.

Please note that reservations are required.

My Shiba Inu's dermatitis had worsened, so I brought him to the clinic for the first time. The consultation, skin examination, and explanation of the treatment plan were all done carefully and thoroughly, and the explanations were very clear and reassuring. My dog ​​is timid, but thanks to the kind doctor and staff, he seemed relaxed.

The clinic was clean and bright, and the app-based booking and payment process was smooth and convenient.

This hospital is clean and the staff are kind and attentive.

If your issue is outside their specialty, they will refer you to a different clinic.

I visited the clinic for a vaccination.

The clinic was very clean, and the doctor was kind and attentive. It was a great experience!

It's a very clean hospital and the examinations are thorough. 
Appointments are made so the examination goes smoothly. 
I plan to continue using your services in the future.
The kind doctors and nurses, and thorough examinations, put me at ease. It's great that I can check my records via LINE or the app.
Thank you for always taking such good care of my cat. My cat was also calm during the examination.

The doctor's explanation was easy to understand, and I felt very at ease during my visit.
The staff were also very helpful, and I would like to continue receiving care there in the future.

I feel at ease knowing that I receive thorough and accurate care at all times, and that the Harajuku clinic works closely with the other clinics to monitor my condition.

The doctors are also very sincere in their examinations, which has eased my anxieties, and I am very grateful.
Thank you for the thorough explanation, covering everything from the illness itself to everyday precautions.

I asked the new clinic to trim my dogs' nails, and they kindly agreed.
I'm also grateful that they're taking care of their health.
The cardboard boat toy that was on display in the waiting room has become a favorite of both of my dogs.
I was so touched by the kind and attentive service I received; I was amazed to find such kind and caring doctors and nurses. I would definitely like to visit again if I need anything else.

I made a same-day appointment, and they were able to accommodate me immediately.

My dog ​​was injured, but he remained calm during the examination.

I use him as my family doctor. I'm always grateful for the thorough examination, with detailed explanations and detailed fees. He always keeps touching my dog ​​while he's on the examination table, making him feel at ease, and he seems to be in a daze during the procedure.
I always feel at ease entrusting my care to you because you examine me so carefully.

We received your vaccinations for our Somali brothers.
Thanks to a thorough medical interview and gentle conversation, they were very well-behaved and received their vaccinations.
Reservations and payment were made smoothly, and the clinic is located in front of Kagurazaka Station, so it's very accessible.
We look forward to your continued support!

This was my first visit, and they carefully inquired about my symptoms and medical history. They explained which tests were necessary, which were unlikely but still performed, and how much the tests would cost. While the fees weren't cheap, I was able to accept them.

They also mentioned that they don't have inpatient facilities, so in case of a sudden change in my condition, they would refer me to a partner hospital.

This was my first visit, and the staff were incredibly kind, explained everything clearly and thoroughly, and I felt completely at ease during my consultation! I would definitely like to come back again!

Recently, my beloved dog was diagnosed with anemia. The hospital determined that a blood transfusion was necessary and referred us to a partner hospital, but they refused to accept him. We then searched for other hospitals, but were unable to find one willing to accept him, and ultimately, my dog ​​passed away a month later.

Considering he lived for a month without a transfusion, I feel that the outcome might have been different if we had received alternative diagnoses or treatment options. I also feel that if we had been provided with information about other hospitals sooner, in case the partner hospital was unable to accept him, I could have responded more quickly as a pet owner.

I hope that you will consider improving your diagnostic methods and inter-hospital collaboration systems so that other pet owners facing similar situations can respond with greater peace of mind. Furthermore, I realized the importance of seeking a second opinion as soon as possible in serious situations.
The clinic is clean and well-maintained. The doctor also explains things thoroughly and in detail, addressing any questions or concerns you may have.
The staff were polite and prompt, making it easy for even impatient dogs to visit the clinic.
The vet seemed a little angry and scary, but he gave my dog ​​a thorough checkup. Thank you! My dog ​​was happy because there were free treats and toys ✨
They were very kind to me, and I trust them.

This hospital provided a reassuring experience with thorough examinations. They explained many things in detail, which was very informative. The clinic was clean and spacious, making waiting comfortable, and they even offered free treats, showing consideration for children who might get nervous.

I would like to continue taking my pet to this hospital.

This was my first visit. My 2-month-old Chihuahua had eaten grape skins, and they helped him vomit. The female doctor and staff were very kind and helpful. I would like to have his next vaccination done here as well.

Dear Ms. Ryoko Denda,
Thank you so much for your kind review!
We will continue to strive to provide even more attentive and warm service so … More

Dear Ai Kosai,
Thank you very much for your positive review!

My puppy had already received its first vaccination at the breeder's, but we had the second dose administered here. I am grateful for the efforts made to reduce stress during visits, the doctor's clear explanations, and the caring and attentive service from the doctor and all the staff.
I always receive courteous service.
The doctor was very kind, and I, as the pet owner, felt at ease entrusting my pet to their care. …
Reservations are smooth and there is little waiting time, so it's always comfortable. The teachers are also kind and considerate, so you can feel at ease.
The veterinary care is accurate and compassionate, making it a reliable animal hospital. …

I've been going there for a little over a year since my first visit.
I currently have two cats under their care, and I'm so impressed by the kind, animal-first doctors and nurses who always talk to them during the examination. ✨ …
